name: permissions
description: Decides what the agent may run as root: sudo for everything, or sudo for chosen tools only (apt, npm, pip, …), and whether npm -g and pip install into its home. Everything is off by default. Security: most of these tools can make the agent root in its container (apt runs packages' install scripts as root), so pick them for convenience, not as a boundary.

settings.label: Tools with sudo
settings.description: Passwordless sudo for these only. apt: apt, apt-get, dpkg. npm: global installs into /usr/local. pip: pip, pip3 (built into the image). chown: chown, chmod, for files containers left as root. mount: mount, umount. network: ip, iptables, ip6tables (built in). tcpdump, strace: built in. mount and network need the capabilities docker-cli's Sysbox gives the container.

settings.label: npm and pip into the home directory
settings.description: npm install -g and pip install go into the agent's home, no root needed.
